prompt_localization: Each canonical Russian question is an intent, not a fallback prompt. The M13-06A runner owns one authored semantically equivalent active-locale prompt for every listed locale. Live local-model execution is deliberately limited to English and Russian; retrieval, generation, sources and scoring for a run stay in that exact locale. The two-locale operational result is reported as the shared selected-model control for all six supported product locales, but it never permits cross-locale retrieval or a false claim of separate model execution in another locale. A native reviewer evaluates answer quality after the content-free execution report.
external_prompt_localization: Each external intent has authored English and Russian prompts. The M13-08 live external benchmark executes both locales only; every provider request, local retrieval result and rendered source remains in the exact active locale. The resulting bilingual external-source control is reported consistently for the six-locale product without cross-locale retrieval or a claim that another locale was independently executed.
